Subject: Pilot sizing & procurement lanes — Redwood follow-up

Alex — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side.

Call highlights (assumptions we used):
- Primary workload: search relevancy + reranking for personalization.
- Expected steady-state: ~1.2M tokens/month; peak (campaigns) up to ~5M tokens/month.
- SLAs: 100–200ms tail latency target for user-facing endpoints; can accept cache-backed fallbacks for non-critical traffic.

Cost & budget framing we discussed:
- Baseline band (what we heard): $8k–$25k / month (flexible depending on commit).
- Redwood target pricing (what we'd propose for a pilot): $2,500–$3,500 per 1M tokens effective rate for a short-term committed pilot with batching/caching optimizations enabled.
- PO/Procurement triggers: finance typically requires a PO for subscriptions >= $10k/month at BrightEdge (per Alex). For Redwood, that maps to our small committed tier vs. reserved capacity ask.

Attachments: attached a lightweight pilot estimate (Redwood-pilot-estimate.xlsx) that maps token bands to candidate monthly charges and unit $/1M token.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm the monthly token band you think is most realistic to budget against (1–2M band, 2–5M band, or 5M+).
2) Introduce procurement owner (PO/finance) so we can align on billing cadence and PO thresholds (Alex, you mentioned Lisa Cheng).
3) If aligned, we'll draft a 3-month pilot proposal (MAP) with a committed spend window and a fallback pay-as-you-go corridor.

If you prefer, we can propose two options in writing: a lower-commit 3-month pilot at ~$12k–$15k/month and a more aggressive $20k/month committed lane (both include 24/7 support during pilot windows).

Thanks — will wait on the band confirmation and procurement contact.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference

Grace — great summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side after a quick sync with product and finance: 

1) Token band reality: our conservative run-rate is ~1.2M / month, but we absolutely need capacity to absorb marketing-driven spikes that could push us to ~5M in peak months. For procurement planning assume a target buffer of ~3–4x baseline.

2) Budget range: leadership is comfortable with an initial pilot corridor that lands between $8k and $25k / month depending on commit. If we can get predictability and a PO-based invoice path, they are willing to lean toward the upper half of that band.

3) Procurement constraints: finance requires a formal PO for any vendor billing > $15k / month. Net payment terms are usually Net30 but can be negotiated to Net45 for pilots (pending legal).

4) Procurement/contact: looping Lisa Cheng (Finance Ops) on this thread — Lisa, can you confirm PO process and estimated lead time once SOW/estimate is in hand?

I'll attach our simple token forecast CSV to make the bands explicit.

Thanks — Alex

Quick internal note / recommendation before we hand this off to legal & solutions: 

Summary of ask: BrightEdge baseline 1.2M tokens/mo, peak ~5M; PO required > $15k/mo. Leadership budget band signals $8k–$25k/mo.

Pricing options to consider for the MAP (3-month pilot):
- Option A (lower-commit): 3 months, commit 1.5M tokens/mo, effective rate $3,200 per 1M => ~$4.8k/mo. Add-on bursts billed at PAYG at $4,500 per 1M.
- Option B (mid-commit, recommended): 3 months, commit 3M tokens/mo, effective rate $2,400 per 1M => ~$7.2k/mo. This keeps list within their comfortable band and avoids immediate procurement escalation.
- Option C (enterprise pilot): 3 months, commit 5M tokens/mo, effective rate $2,000 per 1M => $10k/mo, triggers PO workflow but gives them best unit economics.

Recommendation: Lead with Option B in writing (good compromise on unit economics vs. spend band). If Lisa confirms PO threshold is strict at $15k then we should present Option A and C as clear decision points (Option C requires procurement onboarding but we can pre-stage the PO template).

Action items: 
- Grace: confirm which option Alex prefers to see drafted (A/B/C).
- Marissa: once option chosen, I'll assemble the MAP + quick pricing appendix and push to legal for a short SOW and PO-ready quote. Add a note to ask legal about Net45 for pilots.

-Karthik
